common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: five-picture environment design exploration for the game Prism Route. Create one new coherent landscape concept per call, using supplied images as visual references, not as an exact map to copy. Landscape 16:9 composition, high-quality stylized game environment painting, clear shapes and useful spatial design.
Project: a warm, overgrown post-apocalyptic island made partly from a decommissioned NEAR-FUTURE coastal energy and habitation megastructure. Northern shore stays a gentle sandy beach; southern shore has a small group of broken inhabited artificial cliff terraces. Main southern composition is THREE main land masses only: mainland-connected terrace A, courtyard terrace-island B, and lower habitation island C. Two main elevated connections A-B and B-C, some sea rocks. Terrace roofs roughly 35-55m above sea, inhabited middle zone about 18-28m, lower landing zone 5-10m. Rooms retain human-scale doors, railings and furniture. The scale comes from thick wide terraces and long structural spans, not extremely tall towers.
Architecture: weathered ivory/pale gray composite concrete shells, subtle graphite structural ribs and service panels, rounded-rectangular openings, integrated prefabricated habitat pods and maintenance passages. Large solid quiet surfaces, a few deliberate broken shell sections exposing man-made interiors. Soil and grass cover most roof plates. Calm rounded foliage masses in restrained olive and sage green, a few pink/coral and gold tree groups, golden grass, turquoise sea, clear daylight with softly lit shadows. Retain the reference's vegetation and inviting mood. References are used for their assigned roles; transform the architecture into near-future infrastructure.
Constraints: legible walkable connections, supported bridges with plausible landings, visible room entrances and human-sized circulation. Buildings have inhabitable floors and overhead shelter. Preserve quiet visual hierarchy. Avoid ancient temples, medieval castles, Roman aqueduct styling, Gothic arches, ornamental stone columns, modern urban ruins, skyscrapers, endless tiny islands, impossible towering cliffs, labyrinths of bridges, busy pipes on every surface, neon cyberpunk, excessive visual noise, text labels, logos, watermark, HUD, collage.

images.title: 南部整体
images.detail:
Reference roles in this call: Image 1 is the primary reference for broken coastal terraces, explorable middle rooms and bridge relationships; Image 2 is vegetation/palette/light reference; Image 3 is broad island-landscape reference only, reduce the height and number of its towers.
Composition: a wide elevated three-quarter view across the southern bay, looking inland enough that a distant northern sandy cove is glimpsed behind the grassland. Show all three main land masses A, B and C with complete silhouettes and sea gaps. A is a wide land-connected grassy terrace with one peeled structural face; B is a stepped artificial island with an offset open roof courtyard and a side cave-like chamber; C is distinctly lower and broader with a sheltered inhabited recess. One broad elevated deck links A and B, a shorter second deck links B and C. Let the route and the stepped heights read immediately. Include a small white eleven-meter camper on the upper route for scale, modest warm-lit human-scale windows at mid-height and a low dock. The three cliffs must not resemble giant high-rise slabs. No diagram or labels.

images.title: 高架与管廊
images.detail: Composition: a closer oblique coastal view focused on the A-to-B crossing, upper road deck and a separate enclosed walkable maintenance gallery suspended directly beneath that same bridge. The upper bridge lands flush on both grassy terraces; a small white camper gives road scale. The lower gallery visibly connects a rounded-rectangular cave mouth on A to a matching accessible chamber on B, with occasional side windows and a clear supported structure. One side shell has weathered away to expose a short interior floor and corridor entrance; show a few landings and a staircase returning to the roof, not a maze. Keep ocean visible beneath and enough of lower C in the distance to maintain the three-terrace setting. The elevated bridge and underside gallery are the spatial subject, architecture should read as near-future integrated infrastructure.

images.title: 崖内住宅
images.detail: Composition: human-height three-quarter view from a broad middle-level sheltered terrace into and along the habitation recess in the artificial cliff. The sea and opposite B cliff entrance are visible to one side. About three integrated prefabricated habitation rooms sit inside the weathered thick megastructure, with rectangular doors and windows, simple beds, a small shared kitchen table, storage and a modest repair bench. A substantial overhead shell shelters the rooms. Warm interior light and abundant indirect daylight, airy atmosphere. An accessible balcony walkway and a visible stair/ramp landing link the rooms to the wider island route. A few plants grow at edges, but do not obscure paths. Grass and one rounded tree are visible on the roof above. Make it convincingly livable rather than a dark ruined cave or ornamental facade. No people needed, no labels.

images.title: 洞室与中庭
images.detail: Composition: an architectural game-concept perspective with a clean intentional PARTIAL CUTAWAY of island B, a single scene without text or multiple panels. Remove only a local wedge of its front shell so the inhabitable floor levels can be seen. Clearly show a mid-height side cave-like rounded-rectangular entry leading along a floored corridor to an open-to-sky courtyard with a rounded tree, sunlight and a simple staircase up to the grassy roof. A floor of sheltered living rooms borders the courtyard. The roof bridge arrives at the upper terrace, while the bridge-underdeck maintenance gallery arrives at the middle entry. A lower dock and small landing are visible by the water. Stairs and floors join properly, with a readable short loop from roof to courtyard to chamber. Human-scale interiors, large solid structural mass around them, no cathedral arches or towering hollow megacities. Keep the painterly vegetation and ocean atmosphere of the references.

images.title: 山脊结构切面
images.detail: Composition: ground-level wide view along the island's central grassy ridge towards the coast. The ridge is the broad buried roof and side of a near-future infrastructure shell. A single weathered soil-and-shell section has peeled away, exposing a calm repeated sequence of graphite ribs, pale composite plates and a couple of standard maintenance/habitat chambers inside. Most of the mass still reads as an overgrown hill with golden grass and restrained rounded tree groups. At the foot, a clear human-sized doorway and short path enter a tunnel; a visible opening and sheltered terrace on the far side suggest that it passes through the ridge. Use one sloped structural roof, no extreme spike towers. Glimpse the lower southern terrace group and blue sea in the distance to connect this to the same island. Focus on the surprising reveal of an artificial interior beneath familiar natural terrain.
